hint.none: Drag to move the map, scroll or pinch to zoom. Pick a tool below.
hint.road: Tap the start, then the end, and press ✓ — or just click with a mouse.
hint.curved_road: Tap the start, the bend and the end, pressing ✓ after each — or click them.
hint.bulldoze: Tap a road and press ✓ to remove it — or click it.
error.too_steep: Too steep: make the ramp longer
error.height_conflict: Cross at the same height or a full level apart
hint.roundabout: Tap where the roundabout goes — on a junction to replace it — and press ✓, or click.
star.goal: Get {0} residents where they are going
star.trip: Average trip no longer than {0:0} s
star.spent_and_trip: Spend at most ${0:N0} with trips under {1:0} s
result.title: Level complete!
menu.title: Traffic Game
menu.subtitle: Build roads. Keep the city moving.
level.sandbox.title: Sandbox
level.first_road.title: First road
level.first_road.intro: People want to go shopping. Build a road from the houses to the supermarket.
level.cross_the_avenue.title: Across the avenue
level.cross_the_avenue.intro: The offices are on the other side of a busy avenue. Help people get across.
level.the_jam.title: The jam
level.the_jam.intro: This crossing can't keep up. Try a roundabout.
level.rush_hour.title: Rush hour
level.rush_hour.intro: Two avenues meet and everyone takes turns at the stop signs. The junction can't keep up.
intro.caption: LEVEL {0}
menu.sandbox_details: Build anything, no goal and no budget
hint.traffic_lights: Tap a junction and confirm: traffic lights, then protected left turns, then remove them.
hint.lane_arrows: Tap a junction, then tap a lane's arrow to change where it can turn.
level.rush_hour.hint: New tool: Lights. Pick it below and tap the junction.
level.overpass.title: Overpass
level.overpass.intro: A busy avenue cuts the street in two, and its traffic never stops. Get the residents to the shops on the other side.
level.overpass.hint: New: height. Start the road on the ground, raise the height to 1 with ▲, lead it over the avenue and bring it back down to 0. A ramp needs about 40 m.
level.flyover.title: Flyover
level.flyover.intro: Homes and offices lie on opposite corners of a huge crossroads that is stuck in traffic.
level.flyover.hint: Take the street over the crossroads on a flyover: straight along the diagonal, right above the junction.
